scope: 44 previously witness-only active AWS IDs; independent grouped production base-helper/SDK-to-registered-consumer semantic probes
evidence_boundary: SDK Stubber responses validated against installed botocore schemas; real Requests single-flight cache, pagination/detail helpers, relevant policy decoders and registered evaluators executed. Full provider collect(), unrelated extension stages, live AWS and exhaustive branch equivalence were not exercised. No claim that a fixture or static accessor alone proves semantic completeness.

iam.limit: Only benign s3:GetObject, broad Allow and quoted URL-encoded documents exercised across all inline controls; no complete action-universe, Deny, condition, boundary, group, SCP or effective-access proof. Conditional/public NotAction trust and documented no-login branch separately tested. Services-last-accessed collection is out of scope.

instance.limit: Running instance IPv4/profile/key/VPC branches only; no reachability, effective role access or complete state/IPv6 coverage. No synthetic fields substituted for native optional omissions. Extra extension stages unrelated to these fields were not executed.

bucket.shape: Each named bucket detail is the full native response under its own collected/empty/denied envelope, not a flattened payload. get_object_lock_configuration.ObjectLockConfiguration is nested; no claim about the separately owned sw35 check.
bucket.limit: us-east-1 authenticated GetBucketLocation omission and selected successful/not-found branches only; no directory buckets, alternate Regions, cross-account callers or exhaustive malformed-subfield coverage. ACL group grants remain MANUAL in base control; configured encryption says nothing about historical objects. This is bucket metadata, not sampled object ACL or bucket-wide public safety.

rds_instance.limit: Backup 7/0-day thresholds plus present/omitted VPC/monitor ARN only; replica/Aurora eligibility, engine-specific support, and monitoring functionality not proved. BacktrackingSupported and unrelated RDS fixes are outside this review.

cloudtrail.shape: Status.IsLogging and EventSelectors.{TrailARN,EventSelectors[],AdvancedEventSelectors[]} are detail envelopes. Missing KmsKeyId is explicitly derived as empty string from successful DescribeTrails.
cloudtrail.limit: Basic All management selectors, logging toggle, KMS omission and validation toggle tested; no full advanced-selector truth table, all management-source exclusions, organization trails, multiple-shadow-trail joins or delivery health proof. Scope subject generation separately exercised by immutable snapshot engine.
